CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_share_links (
 id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
 client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
 created_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 last_viewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_client_share_links_token_hash ON client_share_links (token_hash)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_client_share_links_active ON client_share_links (client_id) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL
